articles.title: Orion's Laser Upgrade: Artemis III to Stream 4K Video via Starlink
articles.summary: NASA's Artemis III mission will test SpaceX Starlink laser terminals on Orion, enabling high-bandwidth 4K video from low Earth orbit. The 2027 mission is a crucial step toward a 2028 moon landing.

articles.title: Internet-Famous Eagle Jackie Hospitalized; Chicks Nearing Fledging
articles.summary: Bald eagle Jackie, star of a 24/7 nest cam, was found debilitated and is under veterinary care at the Ojai Raptor Center. Her mate Shadow tends their chicks Sandy and Luna as they approach fledging.

articles.title: NASA Funds 17 Futuristic Concepts: From Solar Dimming to Saturn Ring Drones
articles.summary: NASA's NIAC program selected 17 Phase I studies for 2026, including a dust cloud to reduce solar insolation and femtosat swarms for Saturn's rings. Each receives funding to explore feasibility.
